1. About Cloudlane

Cloudlane is independently published by bdn236 (the “publisher,” “we,” or “us”). It provides a Windows connection to Google Drive for browsing, streaming and file operations, with optional local media caching. Google Drive is provided by Google; Cloudlane is not an official Google product and is not endorsed by Google.

These terms describe use of this website and the publisher's distribution of Cloudlane. Applicable software licenses govern your rights in the software. If you do not agree to these website and service terms, stop using the website and publisher-provided services; your rights under the software's licenses are unaffected.

2. Accounts and requirements

You must have authority to access each connected Google account and to process the files you use. If using Cloudlane for an organization, follow its permissions and policies.

The current Explorer app requires Windows 11 24H2 or newer, build 26100+, on an x64 PC, a working internet connection and same-user administrator approval for drive mapping. Cloudlane must remain running for its connected drives to work. This release requires your own Google Cloud project, enabled Google Drive API and Desktop OAuth client JSON; follow the setup guide. You are responsible for that project’s configuration, quotas, Google account security, your Windows device and the permissions you grant.

Cloudlane is currently provided without an application license fee. Your internet service, Google Drive storage and other third-party services remain subject to their own terms and applicable charges.

3. Your files and actions

You retain ownership of your files. These terms do not grant the publisher ownership of or a general right to use your Drive content.

Copying, uploading, renaming, creating folders and deleting through Cloudlane can change the connected Google account. Completed deletions are intended to move items to Google Drive Trash; recovery depends on Google's retention rules and the account's permissions. Do not assume every operation is reversible.

Uploads and downloads can be interrupted by connectivity, device or provider problems. Verify that important operations have completed. The optional rolling cache is temporary playback storage, not a backup. The Privacy Policy explains local tokens, settings, upload references and cache removal.

4. Acceptable use

Use Cloudlane only for lawful activities and data you have permission to access. Do not use Cloudlane or connected services to:

  • Access another person's account or files without authorization.
  • Distribute unlawful content, infringe others' rights or bypass applicable account permissions.
  • Abuse Google APIs, intentionally evade provider quotas, disrupt services or interfere with another user's access.
  • Misrepresent yourself as the Cloudlane publisher or use the publisher's identity to deceive users.

These requirements do not restrict modification, redistribution or other rights granted by the included software licenses.

Your Google account and Drive use remain subject to Google's terms and applicable Google Drive policies. Google may apply storage limits, quotas, authorization restrictions or verification requirements. Cloudlane cannot override them.

Your own OAuth project is subject to Google’s policies. While a Google OAuth project remains in Testing, only its listed test users can authorize it and Drive authorizations may expire after seven days. Production status alone does not establish Google verification or guarantee unrestricted access. The publisher does not represent that Google has approved Cloudlane unless that approval has actually been obtained.

The website host and external links are operated by their respective providers. Their availability and terms are outside the publisher's direct control.

Features may change and access may be interrupted by maintenance, bugs, Windows changes, Google API changes or provider restrictions. No continuous availability, particular performance or guaranteed support response time is promised.

Review each release's requirements and notes before updating. Updates may require renewed Google authorization. The current installer is unsigned, and Windows may show publisher or installation warnings. Obtain downloads from the publisher's website or another source you independently trust.

9. Ending use and changes to these terms

You can stop using Cloudlane at any time, disconnect drives, revoke access in your Google Account settings and uninstall the app. Uninstallation retains local settings, sign-ins and caches; see the data-removal instructions if you want to erase them.

The publisher may discontinue hosted services or distribution, or restrict access to publisher-controlled services where necessary for security, abuse prevention or legal compliance. This does not revoke rights already granted under an applicable software license.
